title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
content: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.

title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
content: Moscow says nine people have been killed in the past 24 hours, while Kyiv reports four deaths.

title: Russia's prominent anti-war politician jailed for 11 years
content: Lev Schlosberg is found guilty of "discrediting" Russia's army - a verdict he condemns as punishment for his political position.

title: Why did Trump scale back war games with South Korea?
content: US president cites good relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un

title: Gaza flotilla sets sail from the UK in bid to break Israeli siege
content: A boat has left Bristol as part of a wider campaign to break Israel’s blockade and deliver aid to Gaza.

title: Photos: Search for Indonesia earthquake victims continues
content: At least 68 killed in eastern Indonesia as aftershocks and landslides hamper aid.
